messages:
Rae (Design): UX check: when streaming stops mid-chunk the composer jumps. propose: hold final tokens visible + tiny "finalizing" hint.
Oli (PM): agree. keep cost transparency — add "(final)" after token count.
Dee (Eng): doable: snapshot token count on stop and show label for 150ms. will throttle updates to 60ms.
Kai (A11y): announce with aria-live="polite": "Generation finished" and ensure keyboard focus remains.
Rae (Design): prompt library insert should not auto-send; show accessible toast: "Inserted into composer" role=alert.
Oli (PM): add shortcuts notes: Esc=Stop, Ctrl+R=Regenerate in mini-help.
Dee (Eng): will add feature flag: ui.stop-grace and telemetry: stop_mode=grace vs immediate, regen_after_stop, prompt_insert_during_stream.
ops-bot: Experiment flags queued for deploy. :rocket:
Kai (A11y): will review the aria announcements and color contrast tomorrow.
Rae (Design): thanks — will update mocks and share in #design-review.
